evidence.reason: The resume path compares the recorded worktree with the incoming wt before retaining. For an A2 escalation, the recorded worktree is the separate suffixed checkout, while process() is re-entered with the original wt; saved_wt != wt, so the interrupted A2 worktree is skipped and not retained. The pending_judge branch also never restores the recorded worktree, so it can judge or retain the wrong tree while the result still names A2. The recorded worktree should be validated and restored before handling either resume state.
